verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a New Relic feature for tracking/attributing New Relic's own observability spend/ingest usage by team or service, or for alerting on usage spikes before billing (docs-15 covers monitoring customers' cloud/K8s cost, not NR's own consumption). Multiple community reports (new-relic-comm-4, new-relic-comm-5, new-relic-comm-6, new-relic-comm-8, new-relic-comm-9) describe unexpected bill spikes and overages that were not caught proactively, reinforcing the absence of this capability.
